Emma: quick RFC follow-up: proposal for migration shims ("compat shims") attached to bundles so older operators can either auto-apply a tiny migration or get a clear manual plan.
Taylor: short sync sounds good. are these shims executable steps or just docs?
Emma: machine-readable steps. JSON list of idempotent ops: checksums to verify current state, file moves, minimal binary patches (bsdiff style), and post-check validations. example: `{"steps":[{"type":"verify","path":"/opt/redwood/version","sha256":"..."},{"type":"apply_patch","file":"libfoo.so.part","offset":1234}], "sig":"..."}`
Juan: worrying about size churn if every bundle carries shims for many older ops. how often would we include them?
Emma: only for non-backwards-compatible changes. plus size cap: 8KB default, 32KB hard cap. if larger, mark as manual migration and provide offline artifact link.
Sara: UX: console needs two clear states: "auto-migration available" and "manual steps required (airgapped)". For auto we should surface a dry-run and a rollback marker.
Taylor: propose CLI: `redwood migrate --bundle <id> --dry-run` which prints planned operations and creates an audit file when executed.
Kevin: security: shims must be signed by the release key and verified by verifier agent before any step runs. no unsigned shim can be auto-applied. pkg-bot should gate this.
pkg-bot: noted. verifier v0.8 will add shim signature verification and enforcement toggle for private installs. ticket created PKG-1384.
Juan: deprecation policy? we need to avoid forcing operator upgrades overnight.
Emma: 6-month recommended shim window: we include shims for 6 months after a bundle format change. After that, manifest gets `deprecated: true` but installers can still opt-in for another 6 months requiring explicit operator consent and a visible warning.
Sara: metrics: emit `migration_autoop_rate`, `migration_manual_rate`, and `deprecated_bundle_usage_pct` per region. CS wants a weekly export of deprecated installs.
Taylor: testing: add CI matrix job that runs operator versions X-2..X against bundle variations with shims applied. Fail on any silent state drift.
Kevin: for airgapped sites, ensure shims never require external fetch. If a step would fetch, the shim must mark that step `manual` and include offline payload path.
Emma: also include post-migration attestations: operator writes signed activation evidence into activation-audit and returns signature to console for traceability. consider optional HSM signing of post-state.
Juan: rollback semantics: migration must create a reversible checkpoint (image pointer + activation marker). if any step fails, operator should be able to revert to last checkpoint automatically. define clear abort semantics in RFC.
Taylor: i'll prototype a migration sandbox that runs steps with resource/time limits and emits structured logs. will wire into console and CLI.
Sara: one more: accessibility for CS/operators: include a `migration-preview.json` inside the bundle that is human-friendly and printable for change tickets.
Emma: thanks. i'll update RFC with shim schema, size caps, signing requirements, deprecation windows, metric events, CLI UX, and CI matrix plan. ping for reviewers before EOD.
deploy-bot: deployment note: schedule verifier v0.8 and PKG-1384 changes in the next sprint window.
notes: Single-thread Slack export. Messages are short and chronological; contain inline JSON examples and CLI snippets as in real Slack.
